name: Philips India
description: Philips India Limited is an active unlisted public company operating in healthcare technology and personal health, and is a subsidiary of Dutch multinational Koninklijke Philips N.V.

stock.note: Philips India Limited is an unlisted public company; parent entity Koninklijke Philips N.V. trades on Euronext Amsterdam (PHIA.AS) and the NYSE (PHG).

marketing_spend.derivation: Estimated based on FY2024-25 Profit Before Tax of ~₹448 crore and Profit After Tax of ~₹309 crore, implying a revenue base of ~₹3,500-4,500 crore, multiplied by a typical consumer electronics and personal health industry ad-spend ratio of 4-6%.

business_updates.headline: Philips India reports improved FY2024-25 performance with PBT reaching ~₹448 crore and PAT reaching ~₹309 crore
